# Chanx brand

The Chanx logo is the word **chanx**, with **cx** as its short form. The two dots are the
messages Chanx carries: the **c** holds a message to broadcast, and the **x** is a hub where
channels meet and traffic flows both ways.

## Files

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `chanx-wordmark.svg` | Main logo on light backgrounds |
| `chanx-wordmark-dark.svg` | Main logo on dark backgrounds |
| `cx-symbol.svg`, `cx-symbol-dark.svg` | Short form, where the full name does not fit |
| `cx-app-icon.svg` | Square icon: avatars, social cards, app icons |
| `favicon.ico`, `apple-touch-icon.png`, `icon-512.png`, `maskable-512.png` | Browser and device icons |
| `*-black.svg`, `*-white.svg`, `*-mono-1e3a8a.svg` | One-colour versions for single-colour printing, stamps or embroidery |

The icons use a heavier drawing than the wordmark so they stay clear at 16 to 48 px.

## Colours

| Name | Hex | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Navy | `#1E3A8A` | Letters on light backgrounds, icon tile |
| Sky | `#0B9AD8` | The two dots, in every version |
| White | `#FFFFFF` | Letters on dark backgrounds and on the icon tile |

The dots are always sky. The letters follow the background: navy on light, white on dark.

## Rules

- **Clear space:** keep empty space around the logo of at least half the height of the
  letter **c**.
- **Minimum size:** the wordmark at 80 px wide on screen; below that, use the `cx` symbol.
  The app icon works down to 16 px.
- **Backgrounds:** white or the dark docs background (`#121320`) are ideal. On photos or busy
  backgrounds, use the app icon or a one-colour version with enough contrast.
- **Do not:** recolour the letters and dots independently, stretch or rotate the logo, add
  shadows or outlines, or set the name in another typeface. The letters are drawn, not typed.
